claim: The repo prescribes seeded network impairment testing with six profiles (lan to hell) shared between a UDP relay and an in-process C++ simulator, asserting convergence, no double apply and bounded recovery.
evidence: network-chaos-testing.md profiles table; 'hell' = 200 ms +/- 150, 8% loss, 10% reorder, 5% duplicates, 512 kbit/s.
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: UDP only; tools/chaos not run. clumsy (WinDivert) is the suggested system-wide Windows alternative.
next_experiment: Copy the profile definitions and assertion list into Project Mordor's test plan for a future game-free sync core.
